top_categories.workout_context: 60 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic ADAC Velotour (Eschborn-Frankfurt)'s demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
82ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At ADAC Velotour (Eschborn-Frankfurt), surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
ADAC Velotour (Eschborn-Frankfurt)'s mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 60 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of ADAC Velotour (Eschborn-Frankfurt). Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Base fitness for ADAC Velotour (Eschborn-Frankfurt). Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At ADAC Velotour (Eschborn-Frankfurt), that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Low-cadence force work for 4,921ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.heat: May in Eschborn/Frankfurt, Germany can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before ADAC Velotour (Eschborn-Frankfurt) and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for ADAC Velotour (Eschborn-Frankfurt)’s 60 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at ADAC Velotour (Eschborn-Frankfurt). Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 60 miles of mixed terrain in Eschborn/Frankfurt, Germany.
